thread:
maria: FYI billing spike for cust_omega. Console showed provisional ~1.1k, confirmed ~0.9k, invoice ~1.95k. Pattern: streaming -> tool_call -> client reconnect -> fallback -> truncation.

josh: yikes. do we have the trace id? sounds like provisional records duplicated across reconnects.

maria: trace_id trace_2026_06_12_7. Router did two handoffs, provisional slices recorded twice under two session_ids. Finalizer merged oddly.

lee: current provisional key = session_id + chunk_range. reconnect -> new session_id => ledger treats as distinct until confirm. when retries/tool_call overlap we end up double-counting on invoice.

ana: proposal: add billing_attempt_id propagated across stream + reconnects + tool_call hops. internal header X-Redwood-Billing-Attempt. Ledger dedupe by (customer, billing_attempt_id, token_window).

josh: router should synthesize attempt id if client absent and return it so reconnect includes same id. Also propagate into tool_call RPCs.

console-ux: quick UX fix: default dashboard to "confirmed" numbers. hide provisional unless user toggles it on. show a small yellow banner: "Provisional metrics are estimates and may change during finalization."

maria: telemetry: add metrics.streaming.provisional_tokens, metrics.streaming.confirmed_tokens, metrics.billing.attempt_dedupe_count. Also an alert rule for provisional > 2x confirmed in 5m.

lee: storage/ops note: adding attempt id increases index cardinality for provisional records (TTL 7d). I'll run index-cost sim and propose sharding if needed. Backcompat: if attempt id missing, fall back to session grouping.

josh: rollout plan: 1) console hide provisional (quick) 2) header + router propagation (medium, synth-on-reconnect) 3) ledger dedupe behind feature flag + mirror-run 4) opt-in smoothing UX later.

maria: create RFC with repro script. include billing/sre/legal. unit tests + staging e2e required.

billing-bot: InvoiceEvent: provisional_charge emitted cust_omega evt_5555 2026-06-12T14:02:10Z.

ana: opened ISSUE-6770 (api+router) assign @lee, ISSUE-6771 (ledger dedupe) assign @maria, ISSUE-6772 (console UX) assign @josh.

maria: thanks. small follow-up: console should also add an "attempts" drilldown to help ops trace which attempt id caused spikes.

josh: will add that to ISSUE-6772.

lee: I'll post repro + cost numbers by EOD.

maria: great. we'll review RFC in next eng-platform sync.
